data_kind: Observed human responses only; no simulated estimates or model-generated social rounds
reference: 10 initial, pre-feedback reports in the SAME condition

lorenz.comparison: Round 1 before feedback versus round 5 after four opportunities to revise; same 12 people per session-task.
lorenz.metric: Negative expected squared natural-log ratio of panel geometric mean to truth.
lorenz.weighting: Equal tasks within each session-condition, then equal sessions; control session 081121_0739 has only one released question.
lorenz.bootstrap: 12 entire sessions resampled together across all conditions, retaining participants, tasks and both scored rounds.
lorenz.exclusions: No additional response exclusions. Only rounds 1 and 5 scored; both entirely positive. A zero in round 3 is not changed or used.
lorenz.release_caveat: 2022 authors' respondent file, not a reproduction of the 2011 paper's cleaned analysis. One 12-person control task is absent; original extreme entries remain.

kao.comparison: Actual private guess versus actual revision after a displayed computer-generated social cue; not mutual peer interaction.
kao.metric: Negative expected squared error of the arithmetic panel mean, in objects squared.
kao.bootstrap: Paired participant rows resampled within each claimed cue-size N stratum; observed stratum counts fixed. Conditional on this one jar and recruitment sample.

checks.bootstrap_self_equivalence: Initial k=10 verified in every draw in all four comparisons

limitations: Panel size counts recorded reports; Lorenz social reports can include information from other original session members.
Lorenz and Kao use different aggregators and score units. Do not compare their vertical scales or equivalences as a study ranking.
Within-condition before/after curves are not causal between-condition contrasts.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, not formal equivalence tests; unachieved crossings remain censored.
The 2022 paper reanalyzes earlier experiments; the Lorenz file is obtained through its repository, not new 2022 participants.
The Kao paper's fitted correction methods and simulated repeated interactions are not plotted.
